items.description: Fórcola — a precisely carved wooden fitting that holds the oar of a Venetian gondola. Every curve is functional.
A wood carved art piece. Expressive form over function.
A wood carved art piece. The shape exists for its own sake.
An assortment of bolts and windings from a vendor catalogue. Pure hardware.
A regular cog or gear — a fundamental mechanical component that transmits force and motion.
An actual Rorschach inkblot — a standardised psychological diagnostic tool with strict production criteria.
A Rorschach-inspired art piece. It looks clinical, but it exists to provoke, not diagnose.
Archimedes screws — one of history's oldest and most elegant devices for moving water uphill.
A wooden helix sculpture. The spiral form is chosen for beauty and concept, not mechanics.
A spiral sculpture. Geometric and meditative — made to be seen, not used.
